test_cases.name: Vague idea - meeting notes organizer
test_cases.prompt: I want to make a tool to help me organize my meeting notes
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should guide user through clarifying questions about target user, current pain points, core features, non-goals, and tech stack. Should produce a concise one-page PRD.
success_criteria: Asks clarifying questions about user and problem
Generates PRD using the template format

test_cases.name: Specific idea - expense tracker
test_cases.prompt: Help me write a PRD for a simple expense tracker. I'm a freelancer and I need to track business expenses for tax season. Right now I use a spreadsheet but I always forget to update it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should recognize user has already provided context (target user, problem, current state) and focus on extracting core features, non-goals, and tech recommendations.
success_criteria: Suggests non-goals appropriate for a simple prototype

test_cases.name: Overly ambitious scope
test_cases.prompt: I want to build a social network for developers with real-time chat, video calls, code collaboration, job board, and AI-powered matching
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should push back constructively on scope, help user identify the core MVP, and guide them to start with one focused feature set.
success_criteria: Asks user to prioritize core feature
Lists many items as non-goals for v1

test_cases.name: User with partial PRD
test_cases.prompt: I started writing a PRD for a bookmark manager. Here's what I have: Target user is me, a researcher who saves 50+ articles per week. Core features: save links, tag them, search. What else do I need?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should read existing PRD, identify missing sections (non-goals, tech stack, success criteria), and fill in gaps without starting from scratch.

test_cases.name: Non-technical user
test_cases.prompt: I'm not a developer but I want to make a simple website to showcase my photography portfolio. I have about 100 photos organized in folders.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should recognize non-technical user and suggest simpler tech stack (static site generator, no complex backend). Should explain tech choices in accessible language.
success_criteria: Generates actionable PRD for AI coding tool

notes: These test cases cover common scenarios: vague ideas, specific ideas, scope management, partial PRDs, and non-technical users. Each test should result in a complete, actionable PRD that an AI coding tool can execute on.
